acceptance_criteria: Backend selects L1/L2/L3 from stored skill evidence
Backend selects a mode from explicit intent and context
Supportive responses follow policy and are not diagnostic
Only relevant child-scoped context is supplied to the LLM
Cross-child access is denied and deletion/retention are tested
Invalid or unsafe model output is rejected or replaced safely
P95 end-to-end completion latency is below 2000 ms for defined normal load
Child can chat and see persisted progress
Backup restore and rollback are evidenced
